Next, I need to check the net balance for 'birch'.
Finally, I need to check the net balance for 'cobalt'.

I have retrieved the net balances for all three customers: acme (28938), birch (33583), and cobalt (46001). Since I have completed gathering the necessary information and the refunds were provided by Alpha Co, I will now proceed to record a payout for each customer. I must record one payout per customer. I will record payouts sequentially.
Successfully paid acme. Next, I will record the payout for birch.
Successfully paid birch. Finally, I will record the payout for cobalt.
All required payouts have been recorded successfully for all customers. I can now finalize the task report.
